title.zh: 稳定币、数字人民币和“新钱”
title.en: Stablecoins, CBDCs and New Kinds of Money

desc.zh: 一枚稳定币凭什么值 1 美元？从“什么东西算钱”和钱的几层讲起，到比特币为什么难当记账单位、储备型稳定币怎样靠套利守住锚、挤兑怎样打断它、UST 的死亡螺旋、发行人怎样靠国债利息赚钱、数字人民币和支付宝有什么不同，再到美国 GENIUS 法案、欧盟 MiCA 和香港《稳定币条例》，最后是 2026 年 11 月的现状。六个可以动手的模型，只讲机制，不是投资建议。
desc.en: What makes a stablecoin worth exactly one dollar? From what counts as money and its tiers, settlement and cross-border payments, why bitcoin is a poor unit of account, how reserve-backed stablecoins hold their peg through arbitrage, how runs break it, the UST death spiral and how issuers earn from Treasury bills, to how the e-CNY differs from Alipay, the US GENIUS Act, EU MiCA and Hong Kong's Stablecoins Ordinance, and where things stand in November 2026. Six hands-on models; mechanisms only, not investment advice.

title.en: The hierarchy of money: whose IOU it is

desc.zh: 现金、银行存款、支付宝余额和稳定币分别是谁的欠条，每一层怎样承诺按面值换成上一层。
desc.en: Cash, bank deposits, payment-app balances and stablecoins are each someone's IOU, promising par conversion into the tier above.

title.zh: 支付清算与结算最终性

desc.zh: 一笔付款要在央行货币上结清才算完成；跨境汇款要经过代理行链条，所以又慢又贵。
desc.en: A payment is final only when settled in central-bank money; cross-border payments pass through correspondent chains, hence slow and costly.

zh: 跨境汇款为什么又慢又贵

title.zh: 比特币是货币吗：记账单位的检验
title.en: Is bitcoin money? The unit-of-account test

desc.zh: 用一种波动率为 σ 的单位标价，容忍偏离 a 时每年要改价 σ²/a² 次。
desc.en: Pricing in a unit with volatility σ and tolerance a means repricing about σ²/a² times a year.

zh: 稳定币和比特币的区别

title.zh: 稳定币怎样保持 1 美元：储备、赎回与套利
title.en: How a stablecoin keeps its peg: reserves, redemption and arbitrage

desc.zh: 储备型稳定币是一家窄银行：按面值申购赎回，套利把市场价关在成本带里；发行人靠储备的国债利息赚钱。
desc.en: A reserve-backed stablecoin is a narrow bank: par mint and redemption plus arbitrage hold the market price in a cost band; the issuer earns the T-bill interest.

en: how does a stablecoin keep its peg
how do stablecoin issuers make money

title.zh: 脱锚与挤兑：储备、流动性和算法螺旋
title.en: Depegs and runs: reserves, liquidity and the algorithmic spiral

desc.zh: 先来先得按面值赎回时，储备的窟窿或急卖折价都会引发挤兑；没有储备的算法稳定币覆盖率低于 1/d − 1 时会螺旋归零。
desc.en: With first-come par redemption, a hole in reserves or a fire-sale haircut can trigger a run; an algorithmic coin spirals to zero when coverage is below 1/d − 1.

title.zh: 央行数字货币的设计：数字人民币和数字欧元
title.en: CBDC design: the e-CNY and the digital euro

desc.zh: 零售与批发、双层运营、可控匿名、持有上限和计息，以及它们对银行存款的影响。
desc.en: Retail or wholesale, two-tier distribution, controllable anonymity, holding caps and remuneration, and what they do to bank funding.

zh: 数字人民币和支付宝有什么区别

title.zh: 稳定币的法律：GENIUS 法案、MiCA 和香港《稳定币条例》
title.en: Stablecoin law: the GENIUS Act, MiCA and Hong Kong's Stablecoins Ordinance

desc.zh: 三地规则都要求 1 比 1 的高流动性储备、按面值赎回、禁止向持有人付息；生效日期与首批牌照。
desc.en: All three require 1:1 liquid reserves, par redemption and no interest to holders; their dates and first licences.

title.zh: 稳定币和央行数字货币的现状：2026 年 11 月

desc.zh: 规模、国债持有、跨境使用、数字人民币和数字欧元的进展，每条带日期并分为确立、测量和声称。
desc.en: Supply, Treasury holdings, cross-border use and CBDC progress, each dated and labelled established, measured or claimed.
